title: Beacon Enhancement
description: This mod is an auxiliary mod specifically developed for the Minecraft modpack Survivor's Diary, mainly adding the following commands and enhancing the Beacon functionality.
body:
If you only want the Beacon Enhancement feature, you can skip directly to the end.
This is an auxiliary mod designed specifically for the Minecraft modpack Survivor's Diary.
It mainly adds the following commands:
A delayed text command: lazy text <delay> <text>.
<delay> is the delay time in seconds, with a minimum value of 0.1.
<text> is the content you want to display. For example, lazy text 1 Mountains and Seas displays the text "Mountains and Seas" after a 1-second delay.
A delayed command executor: lazyfbt <delay> <command>.
<delay> refers to the delay time in seconds (minimum 0.1).
Any valid Minecraft command can be used after the delay parameter. For example, lazyfbt 1 gamemode creative switches your game mode to Creative mode after a 1-second delay.
A client-side corner text command: xcztxt <delay> <text>.
The <delay> and <text> parameters follow the same rules as above. The difference is that the text appears in the bottom-left corner of the screen instead of the chat window.
A persistent task display command: xcztask open <text>.
This command does not support delay function. Once executed, the specified <text> will be permanently displayed in the upper-middle position on the left side of the screen. Use /xcztask close to turn off the display.
Note: The last two commands involve client-side rendering, which may cause some issues, but the developer does not intend to fix them.
In addition, a new feature is added to Beacons:
When activated, the Beacon will clear all hostile mobs in the 3×3 chunk area centered on itself by default.
The clearing function will be automatically disabled when a Villager enters this 3×3 chunk area.
All related settings can be modified in the configuration file XCZ HET Zone Stabilization Anchor.toml.
